text:
Alex: FYI - GreenCart wants a tiny evidence bundle for a 3-day POC. Needs: SOC2 storage/network excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, EU-only presigned upload (48h), and a clear Dedicated burst overage line for the quote. Can we split tasks?
Priya: I can pull the SOC2 controls (storage + network) and scrub hostnames. Do they want control IDs or just summary?
Alex: control IDs + 1-line plain English summary. Also note EU residency requirement.
Marco: Legal needs vendor + scan scope + contact for the pen-test attestation. Also I'd like to limit presign retention.
Alex: vendor = GreySeal. contact = secops@greencart.io. scope = external storefront + staging subnet. They asked for 48h presign and auto-delete after 7 days.
Dana: I can issue a 24h presign now and reissue 48h once Legal signs. CLI I will run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-eu-proofpacks/greencart/poc.zip --region eu-west-1 --expires-in 86400`
Marco: 48h ok with auto-delete 7 days. I'll draft the attestation: "GreySeal performed external webapp and staging network scans; Redwood did not access customer keys or secrets." Will sign after Priya confirms redaction.
Priya: excerpt prepared, redacted, includes control IDs and EU residency blurb. I'll attach an index of artifacts and a "what we share / what we don't" one-pager.
SalesOps: For Dedicated bursts: short bursts are allowed but billable. Typical uplift range 15-22% depending on GPU class. Send committed baseline (GPUs + hours) and planned burst hours and I'll post a quick line-item estimate.
Alex: baseline = 6 x A10g reserved for 48h, expecting 5h/day burst for 3 days.
SalesOps: will calc and post the estimate in ~30m.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: do not include raw logs or production topology diagrams in external excerpts. Include retention and redaction notices.
Marco: attestation drafted and uploaded to the legal share. Priya, confirm excerpt is the redacted version and I'll countersign.
Priya: confirmed. Excerpt uploaded (redacted) and one-pager included.
Marco: signed attestation uploaded (PDF).
Dana: reissuing presign 48h in eu-west-1: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-eu-proofpacks/greencart/poc.zip --region eu-west-1 --expires-in 172800` (will set ACL private + SSE). Link posted: https://s3-presign.example/gc-6123-48h (expires 48h). Auto-delete scheduled 7 days.
SalesOps: Quick estimate posted: uplift 18% -> approx $1,420 extra for requested burst profile. Attaching calc.
Alex: assembling package and sending to secops@greencart.io with SOC2 excerpt, signed attestation, 48h presign link, the one-pager, and the burst estimate.
GreenCart (via email): "Can you confirm we won't keep uploaded artifacts beyond 7 days and that presign is EU-only? Also can we get a one-line confirmation that Dedicated bursts are charged at the uplift rate?"
Marco: Confirm presign uses eu-west-1 bucket and uploads are auto-deleted after 7 days. Drafted one-line pricing confirmation: "Dedicated bursts are billable at the uplift rate shown in the attached estimate; please contact salesops@redwood.com for custom terms."
Alex: Sent consolidated reply. Customer started the upload. I'll close when upload completes. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
